chunk:
deviations:
  - "Field names use camelCase (not OAGIS PascalCase) — DataWeave convention"
  - "invoiceId maps to OAGIS DocumentID/ID — simplified to flat string"
  - "customerId maps to OAGIS BillToParty/PartyIDs/ID — not nested"
  - "totals maps to OAGIS TotalAmount/TaxAmount/NetAmount — renamed for clarity"
  - "paymentStatus is a canonical addition — not in OAGIS InvoiceType directly"

description: |
  Canonical invoice entity schema across all client integrations.
  Maps from: NetSuite Invoice, QuickBooks Invoice, SAP Billing Document, Salesforce Invoice.
  Primary flow: source ERP → canonical → target CRM (status sync) or AP system (payment).
  OAGIS alignment: InvoiceType — key fields invoiceId→DocumentID/ID,
  customerId→BillToParty/PartyIDs/ID, totals→TotalAmount/TaxAmount/NetAmount.

required:
  - invoiceId
  - customerId
  - status
  - totals
  - timestamps

properties:
  invoiceId:
    type: string
    example: "INV-2024-001234"

  externalIds:
    type: object
    properties:
      netsuiteInternalId:      { type: string }
      netsuiteTransactionId:   { type: string }
      salesforceInvoiceId:     { type: string }
      quickbooksInvoiceId:     { type: string }
      sapBillingDocumentId:    { type: string }
      sourceOrderId:           { type: string, description: "The order that generated this invoice" }

  customerId:
    type: string
    description: Links to canonical-customer

  orderId:
    type: string
    description: Links to canonical-order (the originating order)

  status:
    type: string
    enum: [DRAFT, OPEN, SENT, PARTIALLY_PAID, PAID, OVERDUE, VOID, WRITTEN_OFF]

  paymentStatus:
    type: string
    enum: [UNPAID, PARTIAL, PAID, REFUNDED]

  lines:
    type: array
    items:
      $ref: '#/InvoiceLine'

  totals:
    $ref: '#/InvoiceTotals'

  payment:
    $ref: '#/PaymentInfo'

  timestamps:
    $ref: '#/Timestamps'
